name: KSES URL-value reparse x legacy stored background declarations
hypothesis: The beta4 safe-CSS parser may rewrite a legacy background value when a lower-privilege save reparses unchanged post content.
matrix_cells: 7.0.2 direct parser x beta4 direct parser x pinned safe and unsafe CSS corpus x lower-privilege full-content re-save
positive_control: The new linear-gradient plus URL value survives on beta4.
negative_control: A javascript URL is rejected; legacy safe values remain unchanged.
threat_model: Authenticated author without unfiltered_html; stored-content integrity boundary; no external input or output.

name: Upgrade path x file-removal ledger x clean-tree integrity
hypothesis: Core and WP-CLI upgrade lanes can leave different file trees when the target build removes files not declared in $_old_files.
positive_control: The verified Core-upgrader fixture retains a removed icon-library file.
negative_control: The clean beta4 fixture compared with itself has no extra or missing core files.
threat_model: Integrity boundary only; no security claim.

name: Multisite status flags x network upgrade x first load
hypothesis: A held-back site may remain on an older db_version after the eligible denominator upgrades; first load after restoring the site must be observed before claiming functional impact.
positive_control: A held-back site starts one db_version behind the eligible sites.
negative_control: An eligible site starts at the network db_version and remains unchanged on load.
threat_model: Integrity and availability boundary; no schema-dependent feature is named.

name: Plugin activation scope x dependency resolution x UI and REST affordance
hypothesis: A network-active dependency can satisfy runtime dependency checks while the plugin-card action button treats it as inactive because that button reads only the site-local active_plugins option.
matrix_cells: dependency(network|site|inactive) x intended activation scope(network|site) x viewer(super-admin|site-admin)
positive_control: Network-active dependency: is_plugin_active=true while the action button is disabled.
negative_control: Site-active dependency on the subsite: runtime dependency check and site action button agree.
threat_model: Authenticated site administrator or super administrator; plugin activation capability; default multisite configuration.
